elements.name: CloudControl
elements.caption: Control charging and discharging windows via the cloud
Requires the cloud access in the Alpha ESS system. Changes are sent to the cloud after about 20 seconds.

Works locally without the cloud. Automatic is the normal operation of the system. Any other selection is sent to the system as a command that is valid for 5 minutes and renewed every 2 minutes; if Symcon or the connection fails, the system returns to normal operation by itself. Not available in the mode Cloud only.
